source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Weight loss despite increased appetite, heat intolerance, sweating, and a rapid or irregular heartbeat.","B":"Weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation, and a slowed heart rate.","C":"Central weight gain, rounded face, purple striae, and proximal muscle weakness.","D":"Weight loss, hyperpigmentation, salt craving, and persistent hypotension."}}
source_row.rationale: NIDDK lists weight loss despite increased appetite, rapid or irregular heartbeat, sweating or heat intolerance, and other hypermetabolic symptoms among common manifestations of hyperthyroidism. The keyed response best matches this pattern.
